subject: Chromex continuity review — path to premium SLA and remediation plan
messages:
From: Elaine Jensen <elaine.jensen@chromex.ai>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-11T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Service latency spikes and upcoming renewal

Camila —

Thanks for taking this. Over the last six weeks we've observed repeated latency spikes on inference requests that align with our morning traffic window (07:30–09:30 CET). Token-level tail latency percentiles have increased ~2x compared to Q1 baseline; we've attached a short PDF with the slices.

Renewal for Chromex Analytics (annual) is due 2026-06-01. Before we can greenlight renewal + expansion, our AVP of engineering has asked for a concrete remediation plan and a clear SLA/credit posture if similar incidents recur. Key asks:
- A written remediation timeline we can include in the renewal packet
- Confirmed latency SLO for p95 and p99 for our workload profile
- Whether a premium SLA (dedicated pool) would eliminate the class of incidents we saw
- Proposed service credit structure tied to availability/latency breaches

We'd like to schedule a short working session next week. We're also open to a pilot of a dedicated pool if you can commit to a 30-day carveout for our production traffic.

Attached: chromex_latency_report_2026-04.pdf (pdf)

—Elaine
Elaine Jensen
Head of Platform Reliability, Chromex Analytics
elaine.jensen@chromex.ai
From: camila.reyes@redwood.ai
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-11T10:03:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Re: Service latency spikes and upcoming renewal

Team — forwarding Chromex's report and asks. Quick summary: renewal queued for 6/1, they're asking for remediation plan + SLOs + credits and are open to a dedicated pilot.

Immediate asks from me:
1) Karthik — can you draft a short remediation timeline and an offer for a dedicated pilot (30 days) including expected p95/p99 targets and cost delta? Include whether KV caching / prefix caching we discussed would materially change tail behavior.
2) Priyom — please surface any recent infra events or kernel-level changes in EU region for the last 8 weeks that could explain spikes.
3) Marissa — can you pull the renewal close plan & proposed discount tiers if we offer premium SLA? We'll likely need an ELA/contract addendum.

Target: send a proposed MAP and pilot offer to Chromex by 2026-04-15 so they can review before their leadership week.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: camila.reyes@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-12T08:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Service latency spikes and upcoming renewal — proposed remediation + premium SLA offer

Camila / team —

I've sketched a practical remediation + premium SLA path below. High level: the incidents look like queuing amplification during burst windows; primary mitigations are short-term autoscale tweaks and mid-term dedicated pool + KV cache priming.

Proposal (draft):
- Immediate (0–7 days): apply conservative autoscale headroom to Chromex's service, adjust per-tenant batch caps, and enable prefix KV cache with a 24-hour warm window. Expected impact: reduce p95 by ~20–30% in morning window.
- Pilot (30 days): Dedicated GPU pool (2 x a100 equivalent) in eu-west-1, tuned for their token mix and sequence lengths. SLO commitment during pilot: p95 < 280ms, p99 < 820ms for standard generation requests (based on their sample traces). Pilot includes weekly health checks and a rollback policy.
- SLA (post-pilot): Premium SLA addendum with 99.95% availability for the dedicated pool and latency SLOs mirrored to pilot results. Credit schedule (proposed): 5% invoice credit for availability between 99.5–99.95% (per-month), 15% for 99.0–99.5%, 40% below 99.0%. Latency breach credits negotiable — propose 2% credit for p99 > target in two consecutive weeks.
- Cost delta: estimated +18–25% on top of current spend depending on reserved commitment and burst capacity option. Exact numbers and contract language I can hand off to Marissa for pricing/discounting.

Risks / notes:
- Dedicated pool reduces noisy-neighbor queuing but doesn't remove all application-level tail causes. We'll need Chromex's app team to run a short trace harness during pilot.
- KV caching requires a warm start; cold-starts can still show spikes. We can set a pre-warm job as part of pilot onboarding.

I'll prepare a one-page MAP and a short appendix with expected telemetry checks. Camila — if that matches your ask I'll convert to a customer-facing doc and include a suggested timeline (kickoff 4/20, pilot 4/22–5/21, decision 5/28).

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Product — Serving Runtime, Redwood Inference
From: camila.reyes@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Jensen <elaine.jensen@chromex.ai>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-15T14:06:00Z
Subject: Chromex MAP & pilot offer (CHX-2026-0421)

Elaine —

Thanks again for the data. Attached is a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP_CHX_CHX-2026-0421.xlsx) and the latency slice PDF you sent with our annotations. Summary of the offer:

- Kickoff: 2026-04-22 (week of)
- 30-day dedicated pilot: 2 GPU pool in eu-west-1 tuned to Chromex profile (p95 target 280ms, p99 target 820ms)
- Immediate mitigations: autoscale headroom and prefix KV cache enabled on 4/16 to reduce morning window impact
- SLA addendum to follow pending pilot results; proposed credit schedule included in the MAP
- Billing/pricing: rough estimate included; Marissa will follow up with a formal order form and optional reserved commit discounts

Next steps requested from Chromex by 2026-04-19:
1) Confirm pilot scope and traffic cutoff (what subset of production traffic will be routed to the dedicated pool).
2) Approve the proposed kickoff week.
3) Grant access to a short trace harness (read-only) or share traces for the first 48 hours of pilot.

DocuSign and order form links are in the MAP. If that all works, we can execute the kickoff and get infra ready before your renewal window.

Attachments: MAP_CHX_CHX-2026-0421.xlsx (xlsx), chromex_latency_report_2026-04.pdf (pdf)

Regards —
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai
From: Elaine Jensen <elaine.jensen@chromex.ai>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: reliability@chromex.ai
Date: 2026-04-20T11:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Chromex MAP & pilot offer (CHX-2026-0421)

Camila —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the MAP. We're generally aligned and can commit to the pilot, with a couple of clarifications before sign-off:
- We will route 35% of production traffic initially (morning window) to the dedicated pool.
- We need written confirmation that the dedicated pool will be logically isolated to Chromex traffic (no multi-tenant co-located noisy neighbors).
- Regarding credits: the availability bands look reasonable, but can you add a clause that latency-related credits (p99 misses) are applied only after two consecutive weeks of missed targets to reduce noise?

We reviewed the suggested kickoff of 4/22 — can you confirm infrastructure readiness by 4/21 so we can start the warm-up job? Also, Marissa — please send the formal order form and any contract addendum drafts; legal will want to triage those.

We will sign the MAP doc and DocuSign the pilot order once the isolation and readiness items are confirmed.

—Elaine
From: camila.reyes@redwood.ai
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-02T16:45:00Z
Subject: CHX-2026-0421 — pilot confirmed & next steps (internal)

Team — quick internal confirmation after Elaine's sign-off:
- Pilot scope: 35% of prod routed to dedicated pool; kickoff warm-up job scheduled 2026-04-21 08:00 UTC; pilot window 2026-04-22 — 2026-05-21.
- Karthik: please confirm pool isolation model (tenant-dedicated v. strict single-tenant). Elaine requested logical isolation; legal may push for single-tenant language. We should prepare both options and cost delta.
- Priyom: infra readiness checklist and a runbook for the warm-up job. Also share runbook with Chromex on 2026-05-03.
- Marissa: finalize order_form_CHX-CHX-2026-0421.pdf and push DocuSign; include the credit schedule and the two-week aggregation rule for latency credits per Elaine's ask.

I'll own the customer kickoff on 4/22 and weekly health check cadence; send calendar invites and the onboarding checklist by EOB.

Camila
